mistakes.documentation_evidence: The JavaScript createDraftListing example calls urlencoded.append("image_ids", "378848,238298,030076"); the PHP example encodes the same comma-separated string as image_ids=378848%2C238298%2C030076.
validation_failures: request: RequestBodyValidationError: Request body validation error: Failed to cast value to integer type: 378848,238298,30076 / CastError: Failed to cast value to integer type: 378848,238298,30076 / ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: '378848,238298,30076'
mistakes.reason: The spec defines image_ids as an integer array under application/x-www-form-urlencoded but omits an encoding override with explode:false. The default exploded encoding cannot parse the documented comma-separated value. The same field schema and form encoding are used by updateListing.
mistakes.resolution: Keep the documented comma-separated encoding; record this provider-spec mistake without modifying the node request, tutorial inputs, pinned spec or shared harness.
